agents.name: Failed-payment recovery
agents.headline: UPI payments from HDFC Bank customers on Razorpay timed out on Tuesday, 2–4 pm. Success fell 9.1 points.

causes.label: UPI · HDFC Bank · Razorpay · bank timeout

agents.proposal: Send 600 shoppers who are likely to come back a link with another UPI app or a no-cost EMI, holding 106 back as a control group.
agents.done: Approved. 600 links are queued on WhatsApp through each shopper's original gateway; results against control in 48 hours.

agents.name: Routing advisor
agents.headline: ICICI credit cards succeed 6.2 points more often on PayU than on Razorpay this week.

causes.label: ICICI credit cards sent to Razorpay
Axis debit cards sent to Cashfree

agents.proposal: Move ICICI credit-card traffic from Razorpay to PayU, for an estimated 1.8-point lift in card success. Your payments team applies it.
agents.done: Approved. Revlane will compare success before and after the change for 14 days.

agents.name: Reconciliation
agents.headline: 40 paid bookings were auto-refunded, and 3 marketplace settlements arrived short.
agents.proposal: Offer the 40 auto-refunded bookings back to their customers, and raise 3 settlement queries with the marketplace, evidence attached.
agents.done: Approved. Re-booking offers sent to 40 customers and 3 queries filed; Revlane will check the next payouts.

agents.name: Fee audit
agents.headline: Cashfree charged 2.15% on Amex cards against a 2.00% contract, and PayU charged GST on refunded fees.
agents.proposal: Send overcharge claims to Cashfree, PayU and Razorpay with transaction-level evidence, and track the credits on future settlements.
agents.done: Approved. Claims sent to 3 providers; Revlane will confirm the credits on the next settlements.

agents.name: Subscription recovery
agents.headline: 212 Acme Plus auto-debits failed this month, 61% for insufficient funds in the first 3 days.
agents.proposal: Retry 129 debits after the 5th with pre-debit notice, and send card-update links to 48 members and re-register links to 35.
agents.done: Running. Retries scheduled for the 6th with pre-debit notices; 83 update and re-register links sent.

agents.name: Chargeback
agents.headline: 5 disputes are due within 48 hours; 3 look winnable because payments passed 3D Secure and customers travelled.

causes.label: Low odds: no proof of travel

agents.proposal: Submit evidence-backed responses for the 3 winnable disputes, and accept the 2 with low odds to save handling cost.
agents.done: Running. 3 responses submitted with evidence; 2 accepted. Bank decisions in 30–45 days.

rejected_text: Rejected. Revlane will learn from this and won't propose the same fix this week.

drop.text: Success fell from 87.6% to 82.9% between 2 and 4 pm on Tuesday. 71% of the drop came from UPI payments by HDFC Bank customers on Razorpay, which timed out at the bank; most of the rest was ICICI credit cards failing 3D Secure on PayU. About ₹9.4L slipped away, and 706 shoppers look recoverable.
drop.source: q_204, q_205 · 41,280 attempts · Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree · baseline: same hours, last 4 weeks

lost.text: ₹22.6L slipped away last week across your three gateways, and ₹6.8L has already been recovered this month. Failed payments were the biggest leak, then sales lost on the weaker gateway for some banks, then paid bookings that never reached you. Four fixes are waiting for you.
lost.source: q_210 – q_215 · 3 gateways · HDFC statements · bookings

fee.text: On UPI, none of your providers charges you under your contracts. On domestic cards last month, PayU was cheapest at 1.86%, then Razorpay at 1.92% and Cashfree at 1.97%. Cashfree also charged 2.15% on Amex against a 2.00% contract: ₹2.6L in overcharges is ready to claim.
fee.source: q_220, q_221 · 1,912 settlement lines · Fee contracts 2026.pdf

file.text: I matched the 1,204 credits in your HDFC statement against settlements from all three gateways. 98.7% match to the rupee. Three marketplace payouts arrived ₹1.2L short, and 40 paid bookings were auto-refunded because the order never confirmed — another ₹1.3L.

cb.text: Five disputes are due within 48 hours. Three are worth contesting: the payments passed 3D Secure and the customers travelled. The other two have no proof of travel, so accepting them saves handling cost.
cb.source: Disputes from PayU and Razorpay · bookings · check-in records

subs.text: 212 membership auto-debits failed this month. 61% were insufficient funds in the first three days, so retrying after the 5th should recover most of them. The rest need a card update or a new mandate.
subs.source: Mandates on Razorpay and Cashfree · Acme Plus members

routing.text: ICICI credit cards succeed 6.2 points more often on PayU than on Razorpay this week. Moving that traffic would lift overall card success by about 1.8 points, worth roughly ₹1.9L a week.

wf.text: Here is a draft. When a booking payment of ₹40,000 or more fails, it checks the seat in your inventory system and holds it for 30 minutes, then sends a UPI or EMI link once you approve. Paid: it confirms the booking and posts to your ledger. Not paid: it releases the seat and alerts sales on Slack.

routine.text: Set up as a routine: every Monday at 9:00 I will compile last week's leakage by gateway and by cause and post it to #finance on Slack, with links to any fixes waiting for approval.

routines.text: Here are your routines. You can run any of them now or pause them, right here.

skill.text: Here is a draft skill from what you described. Skills are written instructions that chat and your agents follow every time. Edit it, then save.

fixes.text: Here are the fixes waiting for you. Approve them right here; anything you approve starts running straight away.
fixes.empty_text: Nothing is waiting. Every fix has been decided.

card.text: Here is the plan. You can approve it, change its rules first, or reject it.

steps.title: When a booking payment of ₹40,000+ fails
Hold it 30 minutes, or alert sales if none
Send a UPI or EMI link
Wait up to 30 minutes for payment
Paid: confirm and post. Not paid: release and alert #bookings
